work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Letters CCIX (numeral OCR COIx.) grant the violet collar and a gold medal of the Assumption and s. Cerbonius to the canons of Massa and Populonia; LF44466 → LF44475 across own provenance LF44469 and page number 304 LF44472; complete 17 May 1839 closing. The following running title LF44536 is excluded. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF44431–44431; the source closing at LF44530–44533 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctum Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die decima septima maii millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo nono, pon- tificatus Nostri anno nono. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
